summary: Fun 2D car racing for kids and adults with a variety of difficulty levels.
description: A fresh and fun car racing game for kids and adults, with realistic physics, simple yet challenging levels and hidden secrets! In this 2024 racing game you can race against the clock or go exploring to find all the gems you'll need to unlock new characters and cars. Climb hills, go stunt driving and jump high to find the fastest route to the goal in this casual 2D car game. 🏎️ Cool drivers and vehicles Select your favorite character and car, start your engines, and start driving! Children can learn how to race with the ice cream truck and as they develop their racing skills unlock cool cars like the monster truck, police car or even Santa's sled! 🚓 Easy to learn, challenging to master Race against three other drivers to see who will get the grand prize, or explore the levels and collect all the hidden gems! Feeling fast? Check your ranking in the global leaderboards and try to make it to the top 10 drivers. 🚒 Wide variety of levels Drive across the desert in Santa's sled, race through caves with a police car, climb up and down hills with the monster truck and more! 🛸 Fun racing game for boys and girls Stereotypes not included! Our characters are chosen to be fun for everyone. Ever seen a 2D racing game where you can go driving as a dinosaur, a pizza, or a halloween cat - in a flying saucer or a monster truck? 🚑 Ghost recordings Record your own car racing and compete against yourself! When you really want to beat your previous track record, every little jump matters and the ghost will show you when you slip up. We'd be very happy to hear your thoughts on how we can improve and make this one of the best racing games, so please write a review or send us an email!
